name: tool-execute-code-rpc-write
about: execute_code 经 RPC 回调 write_file / read_file / edit_file / bash（bypassPermissions）：嵌套调用的权限审计记录与文件快照记录落盘，bash 失败转成 RuntimeError。

arguments.code:
from pilotdeck_tools import write_file, read_file, edit_file, bash
w = write_file('/private/tmp/pdrs-bbx/root/proj/made.txt', 'alpha\nbeta\n')
print(w['content'])
r = read_file('/private/tmp/pdrs-bbx/root/proj/made.txt')
e = edit_file('/private/tmp/pdrs-bbx/root/proj/made.txt', 'beta', 'gamma')
print(e['content'])
b = bash('cat made.txt', workdir='/private/tmp/pdrs-bbx/root/proj')
print(b['content'])
try:
    bash('exit 7')
except RuntimeError as e:
    print('caught:', e)

volatileWhy: 工具结果文本里带位数不定的耗时或进程号，文本长度逐次差几个字符，token 估算和字节数随之变；基线自比已证明
